This product is supplied without battery and charger. Makita 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 676YX.

The Makita DHR202Z SDS Rotary Hammer drill can easily drill through steel, masonry and wood and has three operating functions: rotary only, hammer only and rotary hammer. The chisel can rotate a full 360° and has 40 different locking positions for full flexibility. The 18V Li-ion battery improves overall performance and maximises run time. LED light for work in darker areas and tight corners. The side handle, conveniently located push button for forward and reverse modes, and rubber grips make the tool easy and comfortable to use.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
